question: Which of the following gases makes up 78% of our atmosphere and also a part of many molecules essential to life?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer is **Nitrogen**.
 
• Nitrogen makes up about **78%** of the Earth's atmosphere, more than any other gas.
 
• Nitrogen is a crucial component of **amino acids**, which are the building blocks of **proteins**.
 
• It is also a part of the **nucleic acids** DNA and RNA, essential for genetic information.
 
• Nitrogen is critical for plant growth and is often added to soil in the form of **fertilizer**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Property
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Atmospheric Composition
 Nitrogen is the most abundant gas in the Earth's atmosphere.
 
 

 Chemical Symbol
 The chemical symbol for Nitrogen is **N**.
 
 

 Atomic Number
 Nitrogen has an atomic number of **7**.
 
 

 Role in Life
 Essential for the synthesis of proteins and nucleic acids.
 
 

 Industrial Use
 Used in fertilizers, plastics, and explosives.
